# GitHub Pages Branch (Ephemeral)

This branch contains the minimal compiled site layout and synced markdown documentation for the GitHub Pages deployment.

**DO NOT edit this branch directly!**

All content is managed on the `main` branch. A GitHub Actions pipeline automatically triggers on any changes under `docs/` in the `main` branch, processes the files based on frontmatter, cleans up old files, and pushes updates to this branch.

Refer to `main` branch for the project sources and sync workflow.
